decision.observation: 8 mph, gear 1, two light-blue dots lit. The car is on the grass just right of the tarmac, whose edge curves away to the left; white posts mark the lane farther ahead and up-right.
decision.hypothesis: The car has drifted off the right side of the lane onto grass but still carries momentum. A short throttle-left hold should angle it back toward the tarmac without stalling.
decision.memory: Two blue dots = standing water, not a pin. Momentum at 8 mph supports one short steer immediately after a plain-W burst.
